description.zh:
指定要删除的用户所在堡垒机的实例ID。
>您可以调用[describeinstances](~~153281~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the bastion host to which the user to be deleted belongs.

> You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to query the bastion host ID.

description.zh:
指定要删除的用户所在堡垒机的地域ID。
>地域id和地域名称的对应关系，请参见[地域和可用区](~~40654~~)。
description.en:
The region ID of the bastion host to which the user to be deleted belongs.

> For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).

description.zh:
指定要删除的用户ID。
> 您可以调用[ListUsers](~~204522~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the user to be deleted.

> You can call the [ListUsers](~~204522~~) operation to query the user ID.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost delete-user --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --user-id 1 --region cn-hangzhou
